issue_title: [Bug] Todo.from_dict accepts negative id values without validation

triage_summary.root_cause: Todo.from_dict validates that id is int-convertible but does not validate non-negative constraint
risk_points: Data integrity: Negative IDs could corrupt storage state
Edge cases: max() on negative IDs could produce unexpected results in next_id()
API contracts: External systems may assume positive IDs only

source_files.description: Added validation to reject negative id values in from_dict method

test_files.description: Added 3 regression tests for negative id validation (Issue #7176)

risks_and_limitations: Minimal risk: The fix only adds validation, no existing behavior is changed for valid inputs
Edge case: id=0 is now explicitly allowed (previously accepted silently)
